question: Please help me identify the top 3 bowlers who, in the overs where the maximum runs were conceded in each match, gave up the highest number of runs in a single over across all matches. For each of these bowlers, provide the match in which they conceded these maximum runs. Only consider overs that had the most runs conceded within their respective matches, and among these, determine which bowlers conceded the most runs in a single over overall.
sql:
WITH over_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.match_id,
        bb.over_id,
        bb.bowler,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) as runs_from_batsman,
        SUM(er.extra_runs) as runs_from_extra
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON bb.match_id = er.match_id AND bb.over_id = er.over_id AND bb.ball_id = er.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = er.innings_no
    WHERE bb.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.match_id, bb.over_id, bb.bowler
),
over_total_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.match_id,
        bb.over_id,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) + COALESCE(SUM(er.extra_runs), 0) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON bb.match_id = er.match_id AND bb.over_id = er.over_id AND bb.ball_id = er.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = er.innings_no
    GROUP BY bb.match_id, bb.over_id
),
max_run_overs AS (
    SELECT match_id, over_id, total_runs
    FROM (
        SELECT match_id, over_id, total_runs,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY total_runs DESC) as rn
        FROM over_total_runs
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
bowler_runs_in_max_overs AS (
    SELECT 
        mro.match_id,
        mro.over_id,
        orr.bowler,
        orr.runs_from_batsman + orr.runs_from_extra as runs_conceded
    FROM max_run_overs mro
    JOIN over_runs orr ON mro.match_id = orr.match_id AND mro.over_id = orr.over_id AND orr.bowler IS NOT NULL
),
bowler_max_per_match AS (
    SELECT 
        bowler,
        match_id,
        MAX(runs_conceded) as max_runs_in_this_match
    FROM bowler_runs_in_max_overs
    GROUP BY bowler, match_id
),
bowler_overall AS (
    SELECT 
        bowler,
        MAX(max_runs_in_this_match) as overall_max
    FROM bowler_max_per_match
    GROUP BY bowler
),
top_bowlers AS (
    SELECT bowler
    FROM bowler_overall
    WHERE overall_max IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT overall_max FROM bowler_overall ORDER BY overall_max DESC LIMIT 3
    )
),
final_result AS (
    SELECT 
        bpm.bowler,
        bpm.match_id,
        bpm.max_runs_in_this_match as max_runs_conceded
    FROM bowler_max_per_match bpm
    JOIN top_bowlers tb ON bpm.bowler = tb.bowler
    WHERE bpm.max_runs_in_this_match = (
        SELECT overall_max FROM bowler_overall WHERE bowler = bpm.bowler
    )
),
bowler_names AS (
    SELECT player_name, player_id
    FROM player
    WHERE player_id IN (SELECT bowler FROM final_result)
)
SELECT fn.player_name as bowler_name, fr.match_id, fr.max_runs_conceded
FROM final_result fr
JOIN bowler_names fn ON fr.bowler = fn.player_id
ORDER BY fr.max_runs_conceded DESC
